headline: Civil Service Commission Interviews 3 DPS Director Candidates

meeting.body: Civil Service Commission Interviews 3 DPS Director Candidates
meeting.summary: The Civil Service Commission interviewed candidates for DPS director and plans to meet October 7 to review them and hopefully decide.
meeting.recap: The Civil Service Commission of the County of Maui met September 30, 2026, at about 9:02 a.m.[[0:00:31]] The meeting was for interviews of candidates for DPS director.[[0:01:34]] The first candidate said his approach would have a strong labor focus built on trust.[[0:05:13]] The commission voted to meet in executive session (a closed-door discussion) about the first candidate, for privacy.[[0:54:04]] The second candidate said he is a public works deputy director with 11 years at the county.[[1:01:11]] He said DPS turned down his department's retention incentive plan as too hard to negotiate.[[1:42:56]] She said she is applying because she worries the county's HR project could fall flat.[[2:35:55]] Commissioners plan to meet October 7 to review the candidates and hopefully decide.[[2:48:53]] The final choice will be made by majority vote, not consensus.[[3:22:07]] A commissioner said if none of the three fits, the commission may start over.[[3:43:53]] The commission met again in executive session to consult its attorney about public testimony.[[3:46:48]]
decided: The commission voted to go into executive session (a closed-door discussion) about the first candidate, for privacy.
The commission voted to go into executive session to consult its attorney about including public testimony.
The commission voted to adjourn at 2:52 p.m.
meeting.next: Commissioners may ask the candidates follow-up questions by phone and bring the answers back to the whole commission. Public testimony will be accepted up to the day of the meeting, but earlier written testimony gives commissioners more time to review it. Scores may be discussed in executive session because they contain sensitive information. Candidates will be told the commission's decision.
